page_title: ATM 2-0 PAL | Atletico Madrid v Las Palmas 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

90+6' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
88' Viti (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea had an easy-decision to make.
87' Substitution. Kirian Rodriguez makes his way off the pitch and Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
87' Substitution. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) has come on for Fabio Silva.
86' The corner kick from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
85' The corner from Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
84' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Giuliano Simeone will be replaced by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
84' Substitution. Javi Galan makes way for Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
83' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Rodrigo de Paul feeds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top left corner.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) will replace Alex Suarez.
78' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) trips an opposition player and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a foul.
78' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
73' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
72' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
71' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
71' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
69' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
65' Substitution. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) replaces Julian Alvarez.
65' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Antoine Griezmann and he is replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is replacing Jose Campana.
64' A substitution has been made. Sandro Ramirez is replaced by Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas).
64' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
64' It seemed like Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
62' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
60' It looks like Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Diego Martinez replaces him with Dinko Horkas.
58' The injury to Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
56' Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
52' Looks like Jasper Cillessen (Las Palmas) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
49' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Antoine Griezmann was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
48' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
47' The attendance for today's match is 56610.
46' Half-time substitution. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Conor Gallagher.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) comes on the pitch for Pablo Barrios.
46' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from inside the penalty area straight onto the crossbar!
45+2' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+1' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece.
45+1' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
43' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
40' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
37' 1 - 0 Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
35' A rebound falls to Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
35' An attempted cross from Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
34' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
33' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
32' A short pass finds Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
32' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
27' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
27' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jasper Cillessen intercepts the ball.
25' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
22' A corner kick by Las Palmas is thwarted by the well prepared Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid).
21' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Jan Oblak is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
20' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes it short.
20' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
18' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
15' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

12' Play continues despite the shouts by some Atl. Madrid players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
10' Viti (Las Palmas) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
8' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.

8' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Jasper Cillessen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
6' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jasper Cillessen is quickest to intercept the ball.
1' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atl. Madrid will kick the game off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
